items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 20:1
items.html: (To the question) The NHY of the Ima of the AB of the Mazal, which clothe in the Nukva when she is back to back, in an equal stature with ZA — behold, also the NHY of Aba are included in them; and the aspect of the Malchut of Aba, which is in his Yesod, shines outside the Yesod of the Nukva, and it is the aspect of the long Yesod of Aba, meaning the aspect of Hochma that shines there, for the illumination of Hochma is called long, as is known. And this has already been explained above in Answer 63, see there.
